evidence.detail: Launcher constructs exactly one rs/gui/E and stores it as the panel that directly contains the live rs.Client component.
Launcher configures the panel with BorderLayout, black background and 765x503 client dimensions in the fixed shell, then adds the live Client component at BorderLayout.CENTER.
The panel is inserted into Launcher's main horizontal Swing container beside R145 ClientSidebarPanel, fixing it as the central client viewport host rather than a generic JPanel.

evidence.detail: R145 ClientSidebarPanel constructs rs/gui/L and installs it directly on its live JTabbedPane through addChangeListener.

The class owns only its synthetic ClientSidebarPanel reference and performs no feature-specific tab logic or unrelated state mutation.
